A [Reed--Solomon code](error-correcting-codes.qmd#def-reed-solomon-code) corrects errors up to half its [minimum distance](error-correcting-codes.qmd#def-hamming-distance).
Past that radius a received word can be near several codewords,
and a decoder can return all of them as a list.
